# NumCases direct Pop and continuation

This focused fixture preserves 112 complete responses from D2's frozen MathJax 3.2.2 original at `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`, with actual merged Go base `c24058161bb5df6af3f269ce65030c94079b952a`. Every request uses fresh original state, explicit display mode, Em=16, Ex=8 and FontCache=0. The public package profile is unchanged. The inputs author AMS `DeclareMathOperator` and mathtools paired-delimiter declarations through their actual TeX programs; no count or package state is injected.

`numcases_direct_pop_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` contains 100 complete `{svg}` responses: 48 normal SVGs and 52 error SVGs, all valid XML. It combines the initial 44 eligible SVG records with 56 tag, label, suffix, equation-nesting and physical paired-macro-prefix risk records. The latter include real repeated prefixes at 996–1000; their full original outputs distinguish successful continuation from the source substitution-limit diagnostic. The public test compares every full SVG with `DefaultOptions` and explicit Display.

Eight inputs promote previously held ordinary-array originals to strict assertions. Their complete historical residual objects, source memberships, held reason and original APIs remain unchanged, and the test checks them against the untouched ordinary-array residual archive. Their former mismatch is not an expectation or a new-input credit. The other 92 SVG inputs are absent from all 548 tracked testdata JSON/JSON.gz files at the actual base according to the bound exact-string newness receipts. The 56 risk keys are also disjoint from every initial56 request.

`numcases_direct_pop_original_runtime_mathjax_3_2_2.json.gz` separately preserves twelve complete raw original `{error}` objects: four empty-Pop `copy` exceptions and eight popped-matrix spread-dimension `match` exceptions. This archive, including its initial56 provenance, source-union hash and complete runtime errors, is byte-identical to the first prepared bundle. Its preservation test validates the complete source records without invoking the Go converter or inventing a substitute SVG/API outcome.

Four native continuation tests execute the entire authored public TeX through `newParseState` and `parseRow`, without seeded registers, counter changes, augmented packages or constructed End items. Their expected final cursor (109/115), macro count (3), mi-x / matrix / + / Z ordering, oldest-mi explicit attributes, matrix attributes and retained Cases tag state come from independently qualified passive original observations. `StackItem.Last` selects the oldest node. The tests do not impose a full original tree, duplicate stack-object identity or the original text node's unusual appended mtd child shape on Go's representation.

The 100 strict references and four native physical continuation tests passed against the proposed production source. Fresh original-only regeneration matched all 112 complete source APIs and reproduced both archives byte for byte. The protected replay covered 146,639 distinct inputs and 164,719 source/consumer associations, with 20 stable Cases SVG fixes, four separately qualified noncausal attribute-order controls and twelve separately preserved original-runtime boundaries; no genuine SVG or consumer regression remained. All 103 complete D2 witnesses matched their original references. Bound root and independent-peer receipts are in the inventory. Final full/race/vet/WASM and hosted CI are recorded separately for the exact published commit. The initial44 draft and its handoff remain frozen. This finite 100-SVG corpus does not establish whole-package or full-stack parity.

## Original-only regeneration

Run the pinned Node binary with `generate_numcases_direct_pop.cjs PINNED_ASSET_DIR NEW_OUTPUT_DIR ORIGINAL_ORACLE_PATH`. The third argument must be the exact initial runtime capture path stored in both archives, `work/mathjax-go/testdata/differential/oracle.mjs` under the recorded workspace. The script verifies the binary, unchanged oracle and frozen asset hashes before invoking that oracle. The 56 risk captures used the identical pinned script in the other source checkout and produced only SVGs. Combined regeneration uses the initial runtime capture path for all requests and requires every complete API object to equal its saved original; another path is rejected, and errors are never normalized or replaced with first-line-only expectations.

The generator orders all 112 source requests by sourceUnionIndex. It saves raw LF-framed stdout and stderr before validation, then records all detached complete API objects before equality assertions. It copies the 100-SVG archive and unchanged twelve-runtime archive byte for byte only after every fresh original object matches. Failures retain raw evidence. It never invokes Go or reads a current/candidate response. The SVG archive has combined112 source provenance; the separate runtime archive deliberately retains its initial56 header.

Focused scratch verification adds both nonexistent test files through Go's overlay and sets `MATHJAX_GO_NUMCASES_DIRECT_POP_FIXTURE_DIR` to the new scratch testdata directory. The test-only override applies only to the two new archives. The historical residual archive is read from the tested checkout and hash checked. With the bundle installed, the default path is the repository's ordinary `testdata` directory.
